subject.title: fix(agents): xAI/Grok requests fail after a stale reasoning replay ("could not decrypt encrypted_content")

question: Should this PR's pre-fix production logs plus focused positive/negative predicate tests be accepted as proof for the non-inducible xAI/Grok code-less encrypted_content decrypt error, or should merge wait for organic after-fix logs?
rationale: ClawSweeper's normal external-PR gate requires after-fix real behavior proof, but the author supplied a plausible provider-side trigger constraint and the code path is a narrow matcher over an already-tested one-shot retry.

options.title: Accept a proof override
options.body: Treat the redacted pre-fix logs, focused tests, and green checks as sufficient for this provider-side rotation error and proceed with normal maintainer merge review.

options.title: Require organic after-fix logs
options.body: Keep the PR blocked until a future xAI rotation yields redacted gateway logs showing the retry succeeds after this patch.

options.title: Pause if proof cannot be accepted
options.body: Leave the PR open or close it if maintainers decide after-fix real provider proof is mandatory and cannot be produced in a useful time window.

recommendation.title: Accept a proof override
recommendation.body: Treat the redacted pre-fix logs, focused tests, and green checks as sufficient for this provider-side rotation error and proceed with normal maintainer merge review.
